t: I attended your ExcelPaces course in October 2024 and am delighted to inform you that I passed PACES on my first attempt. Thanks to the training I received in your programme.
I would like to convey my thanks and regards to you, Ms Jessy, all the examiners and the entire team for your help and guidance.

I am happy to inform you that I have passed the MRCP PACES exam. My exam was on 9/11/2024 in Hyderabad, and I scored 155/168.

Please forward my utmost gratitude to the faculty for their guidance and training. I can still hear each message clear in my head. Without them, I doubt I would have cleared this exam. Please send my regards to Dr Saifudeen, without whom I may not have passed the Neurology Station (for which I scored a surprising 20/20).

Furthermore, thank you to you, Ms Jessy, and your team for organising this course so seamlessly. Also, my gratitude to the patients who showed up to be examined multiple times, which must have been uncomfortable. I wish Excel Paces success for many years to come.

I am happy to inform you that I have passed MRCP Paces conducted in Oct 2024 Chennai.

My wholehearted gratitude to the all Teachers & Supporting Staff of Excel Paces team. Thanks for the wonderful training sessions and support.
It was very organised. There was no lag in any of the days. It was perfectly planned and we were kept engaged all the three days. I found it useful. It changed my approach towards the exam.

This is the only course in India with UK Examiners. This will help us how the UK examiners in real exam think and expect us from & to know how they mark accordingly. This course gave so much of knowledge in short time. Thank you
After having attended the course, I have realised a lot of what I need to focus on. I would say without attending this course, my chances of passing would have been much lower.
I think it was a brilliant experience. Can’t be better than this. The team just rocked it. Kudos to all of you. Thank You!

The course was very much helpful. I have done my MD exam 3 years ago and MRCP Part II, 4 years ago. I was very well taught from basics and it has given me lot of confidence to appear in the exam & also on my daily clinical practice.

This course is not the place to learn the basics, but to sharpen your skills & train your instincts. The course provides opportunity to face your fears in a controlled environment, and equip you with the skill, confidence, and direction for your exam.
Coming with Respiratory medicine back ground. Excel PACEs helped me to get thorough ample amount of knowledge and exposure in other specialities as well. Helped me to gain confidence to appear exam
Definitely one of the best courses in the country! May be even in the whole world. Outstanding faculty. Good emphasis on hands on training

A very comprehensive course, more beneficial if you do your homework and not come with a clean slate! All the faculties are very generous & hell bent on making you prepared better for PACES! A must – attend by every exam going candidate!

Wonderfully organised surpassed all my expectations. The examiners were very kind and encouraging and I finally got a realistic experience to help me prepare for PACES. Thank You to the whole team of organisers and examiners.
Very well organised course and informative. Helps to prepare the candidate to a new system of examination
A big thanks to the organising team lead by Ms Jessy and all the examiners. Hopeful of passing my exam

Overall, a very good course. It instils a lot of confidence in candidates. Wishing all the best for the teachers and all the support team, who made us confident and comfortable during the entire course.
Comprehensive course one must attend before going to MRCP PACES

My sincere thanks and gratitude to the organizers and teachers of Excel paces as I have passed the MRCP Paces exam after attending the 2013 course. This success at the first attempt would not have happened without the excellent guidance from The Excelpaces team. This course is very effective and helpful in training candidates preparing for MRCP Paces. I strongly recommend all PACES candidates to attend this course. Finally, I wish all success to the organizers and teachers of this course.

I attended the 2013 Excel Paces course which I felt, was a really useful course. I would like to thank all the Examiners and staff of the course and want to inform them that I passed the PACES exam in Oman.

Dear sir,
I am Dr. Kantha Rao from Malaysia I attended Excel Paces in October 2012 and I have passed MRCP PACES in first attempt. My heartiest thanks to all …organizing committee and all the examiners. I will recommend the course to all in Malaysia.

Dear Sir,
I had attended the PACES course at KIMS Hospital recently. I am happy to inform you that I passed the MRCP PACES exam at Basildon centre in the UK conducted on Oct 19. I felt the course to be very helpful. Thank you very much for the help and support.

Dear Sir,
I attended the recent EXCELPACES course last month. I am sending you an email to show my appreciation. I just got my MRCP PACES result and I passed first time. I would like to express my sincere thanks to everybody in the EXCELPACES team, for helping us arrange transport to and from the hospital; to the patients and surrogates for letting us examine them; and to all the tutors for their guidance, criticism and patience in teaching us. They provided valuable feedback that allowed me to shape up my performance. I saw a good variety of cases. The surrogates were also well primed. I would definitely recommend this course to anybody who is attempting MRCP PACES.

Please convey my gratitude to all the tutors.

I gave my PACES at Chennai this march and passed in my first attempt.
The MRCP PACES course was really excellent and did teach me a lot and boosted my confidence very much. All the examiners were very sincere in teaching and were extremely knowledgable.
They were all very serious in teaching and I was really impressed with the standards of all examiners especially Dr Alan, Dr Donald, Dr Sunil, Dr. Prasad, Dr Sahadullah and Dr Saifudeen. I really learned where my mistakes are and how to approach the exam.
I am really indebted to Excel paces and the entire team of doctors , without whom it wouldn’t have been possible for me to clear this exam.
Thank you so much!

Thank you sir and thank you to all the EXCEL PACES TEAM
I have passed the MRCP PACES diet at my first attempt, and scored 160/172. I am grateful to the whole support and the excellent training that I have got from your course. I would definitely recommend this course to any one who is planning to appear for the Exam.
Thank you again
I passed paces in the first attempt. Scored 90%. Thanks excel paces…

Thank you Excel PACES for giving me appropriate guidance of how to stay focused in exam even if one station gets bad, and it really helped me to PASS PACES held recently in Oman (Oct 2014)

I have never seen so many trained, experienced and knowledgeable active Paces examiners under one roof working to polish our skills whether in focused station 5, or in communication skill station. I believe that your MRCP is incomplete if you don’t get to attend this wonderful course. Besides teaching and getting flash training you will get an opportunity to sing also in the concluding dinner party of the course…Well done Excel Paces. I would like to thank each and every examiner, the organizers and the brilliant corresponds of the whole Excel Paces team..

Your course is not only highly recommended, it is a must for every aspirant of MRCP Exam.

My heartfelt thanks to the EXCEL PACES team and all the teachers who trained us for the PACES in October 2014. I happily inform you of my success in the first attempt for PACES at the Chennai centre in Nov 2014. I am grateful to all the teachers who trained us well and oriented us to be prepared for the exam. The supporting team at the centre for EXCEL PACES requires special credit for the 4 day course tailored to perfection. Thank you once again for all the support and teaching given during the course without which the exam would have been much tougher to face.

I am happy to inform you that I have passed MRCP Paces in my first attempt. I received excellent guidance from the faculty members in Excel paces. I thank the faculty team for their guidance and support during the course.

Glad to inform you that I have passed PACES exam, conducted at Chennai this March.
I am extremely thankful to you for your classes and videos. Excel paces course was of immense help in getting through the exam.

I will need your valuable advises for my future plans too and I shall contact you for that.
I cleared both MRCP in first attempt after going through EXCEL PACES at KIMS Trivandrum ! I recommend to attend EXCEL PACES to Excel in PACES !

I’m Dr. Md Mahin Reza, working in Holy family red crescent medical college hospital, Dhaka, Bangladesh.
I’m really happy to inform you that I have passed the PACES in my first attempt (Colombo 2017/3 Diet). Lots of thanks for making me confident for the exam. Excel paces is just wonderful.

I am so glad to inform you that I have cleared the MRCP exam from Cochin center. Thanks to the whole team for their guidance. The course was extremely useful and I want to individually thank the whole team.
I want to thank you sincerely for all the efforts u put in making this course so comfortable for us. Hope we all pass and make u all proud of teaching us.

By the grace of Allah I have passed my MRCP (UK) PACES on March 2018. My examination venue was Kochi-Aster Medcity, India. Thanks to all members of the EXCEL PACES team for their outstanding support and cooperation

Excellent course. Time is well utilized to understand what the examiners want. (All instructors are real PACES Examiners) Gives the feel of real exam. Originally it took away a lot of my fear and anxiety. My compliments!!! Strongly recommend.

DON’T JUST PASS THE PACES, EXCEL PACES.
Truly custom-made course to give a clear understanding of PACES Exam and the examiner’s expectations from candidates.
Great course done by national & International faculties. Very useful tips about passing PACES examination and will make you confident.
Genuine intention to help MRCP aspirants. Candidates are equipped to achieve their goal by a group of passionate, skilled & qualified team.
Very well-organized course. Well selected cases. Brilliant morning presentations. Helpful. Experienced instructions. Expert organisers.
An excellent course. Anyone planning to do PACES should attend. Knowledgeable and real MRCP Paces examiners training you with real patients. Must have

This is one of the best PACES courses I came across. Highly organized. Almost every single person was given a chance to examine, interact and learn. Faculty was awesome, very knowledgeable and interactive cases selected. They were also close to the real exam.
Highly recommended to those who attend PACES.
Really valued the insight & feedback given by the examiners. This course gave a fair idea about the exam day scenario to help and prepare for the same. Good course overall, highly recommended.

This course really helped me a lot to get better understanding of the exam. However, I wish they could have shown more cases and not just mainly focus on examination technique. But overall an amazing course, especially for beginners.

The course is well designed for one exam going candidate. It is a must to attend it a few weeks before the exam, as the course highlights variety of patients, examination methods, and presentation to the examiner and a whole lot of tips to follow and pass the PACES.
